title: Stunt
description: A stunt for a character in a Role Playing Game.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the schema for the data.

type.description: The type of thingy the data describes, 'stunt'.

description.description: A description of the stunt describe the mechanical or narrative effect of the stunt and the conditions under which it applies. Markdown allowed.

mechanics.title: Rules mechanics
mechanics.description: A list of rules mechanics that are triggered by this stunt.

mechanicType.title: Stunt mechanic type
mechanicType.description: The type of rule mechanics this stunt enables.

parameters.description: The details of the mechanical effect of a stunt.

trait.description: The trait (from the 'trait[].name' list) that the mechanics of this stunt applies.

modifier.description: How many points should be applied as the mechanical effect of the stunt. It can either add to a roll or the shifts of effect from the roll when successful.

actions.description: The action types to which the mechanical effect applies.

modificationType.description: The part of the resolution task to which the modifier is applied, either the total of the roll, or the total of the effect when the roll is successful.

consequenceLevel.title: Consequence Level
consequenceLevel.description: The level of the consequence, Mild (2), Moderate (4), Severe (6). The track must be manually included in the "tracks" property.

trackLabel.description: The label or title for this track.
